headline: Assaí Posts 55% Q3 Profit Surge and Advances Deleveraging
summary: Assaí released its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting an adjusted recurring net income of R$ 248 million, which marks a 55.2% growth driven by its business model resilience amid a pressured consumer environment.
why: Assaí is a major Brazilian cash-and-carry wholesaler whose performance serves as a key indicator for Latin American consumer retail health and macroeconomic demand trends.
